fusions.name: Ley Burst
fusions.desc: Hurls a surge of raw arcana that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Ground Tremor
fusions.desc: Stamps out a shockwave that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Swelling Mass
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Stray Aegis
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you gain a shield worth 6% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
